summary: Frontend test of the Guardian Journey owner-bug fix and the iteration-90 follow-up fixes. Run on the Expo web preview (375x667) as voicetest2026@example.com, with fake 900000000x numbers and window.open stubbed to capture sms: links. OWNER BUG FIXED: from Women's Shield → Guardian Journey (/women/guardian-share, no params), the destination field and the 15/30/60/120/Custom duration controls are present and editable. With 'TEST_Library Road' and 30 min, one tap on Prepare made exactly 1 POST /api/journey/status and opened exactly 1 sms: link. Its body had the destination and a check-in time of tap+30 min (01:07 PM; the default 60 would have been 01:37 PM). The row then read 'Message prepared — press Send in your SMS app'. Empty destination: Prepare is aria-disabled, guardian-need-destination shows, and a forced tap made 0 POSTs and opened nothing. Field locking: after the first successful Prepare, the destination and custom inputs are read-only, the chips are aria-disabled (tapping 15 changed nothing), and guardian-fields-locked is shown. Custom duration: 0 and 1441 entered with fill() show guardian-duration-error and leave 60 in effect; 45 is accepted and shows in the check-in time and the preview. BUG: typing 1441 one key at a time (as a real user does) shows the error but leaves the duration at 144, so check-in becomes 03:01 PM. Prepare also stays enabled while the error shows. Head Out: GO1B GPS is on, so Head Out creates the record on Start. Notify guardian then opens guardian-share pre-filled (destination, 120 chip) and already locked, which matches the design. With Head Out's POST blocked, the fields are pre-filled AND editable, the edits are used for the record, and the screen locks afterwards. Revoke fix VERIFIED: as fir-test-user2, /guardian/<token> for a revoked in-progress journey shows guardian-closed-card 'Sharing has ended' with no LIVE, and no destination, area or coordinates. The API returns status=in_progress plus closed_at. Create-failure fix VERIFIED: with POST /api/journey/status returning 500, the preview and the SMS both say '(Status link unavailable…', there is no '[status link will be added]', guardian-create-error is visible, the fields stay editable, and the next Prepare retries the create. Iteration-90 regression PASS: one SMS per contact; banner says 'prepared'; notify=false and no-phone contacts are hidden; 112 is blocked with guardian-prepare-error; gpsLive=0 gives 'Check my journey status'; no localhost warning; mark-safe 500 shows safe-error + retry; withdraw 500 shows revoke-error + retry, and the retry succeeds; GPS made 0 geolocation calls before the consent tap; gps-allow-btn is 44px tall. Wider smoke PASS: Women's Shield, Silent Alert (one sms: only after a tap), Evidence Locker PIN gate, Family Journey hub/new, Nearest help, and Head Out search (3 suggestions + map) all load with no page errors and open nothing without a tap. The dialler 112 card was tapped without error, but tel: navigation cannot be observed on web. Deprecated packages detected: none (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch).

ui_bugs.issue: Each keystroke that forms a valid prefix is applied, so typing 1441 sets durationMins=144 (check-in moved from 01:37 PM to 03:01 PM) while guardian-duration-error says the value is invalid. Prepare stays enabled while durError is set, so the record and the SMS would use 144 min. Typing 2000 the same way would give 200. Reference: app/women/guardian-share.tsx:282-290 and :370

A Head Out duration that is not a chip (e.g. 4 hours = 240) highlights no chip and leaves Custom empty. The user can only infer the duration from the check-in time. Reference: app/women/guardian-share.tsx:51-52

integration_issues.flow: Head Out → Notify guardian when Head Out's record creation failed
integration_issues.issue: startedAt is seeded from the Head Out startTime (guardian-share.tsx:55), so the SMS check-in is session start + duration. The record created later at the Prepare tap sends only duration_mins, so the backend deadline (status page and missed-check-in alert) is Prepare time + duration. The two differ by however long passed between Start and Prepare.

If the create fails, startedAt stays 0. The check-in time keeps moving with Date.now(), and the fields stay editable, so contacts prepared one after another can get different times or destinations. LOW.

issues: headout-notify-guardian uses styles.button, which has no paddingHorizontal and is not stretched. It shrinks to its content and 'Notify your guardian' touches the right border (screenshot it91_headout_active). Add paddingHorizontal: 16 and/or alignSelf: 'stretch' (app/women/head-out.tsx:620-628).

action_items: MEDIUM: guardian-share.tsx:282-290: commit a custom duration only when the whole value is valid. Either apply it on blur/submit, or restore the last valid duration whenever the value goes out of range. Also disable Prepare (line 370) while durError is set, so 1441 typed one key at a time cannot become 144.

LOW-MEDIUM: guardian-share.tsx:55/136: when the record is created here (no journeyToken from Head Out), make the SMS check-in match the backend deadline. Either set startedAt to the creation time, or send duration_mins = remaining minutes from the Head Out startTime.
LOW: when the incoming duration is not 15/30/60/120, pre-fill guardian-duration-custom with it.
LOW: head-out.tsx:620: add paddingHorizontal (≥16) / alignSelf:'stretch' to the Notify-your-guardian button.
LOW: useJourneyGPS.ts:161: wrap watchPositionAsync in try/catch, so a rejection does not become an unhandled promise.
critical_code_review_comments: guardian-share.tsx is about 620 lines, close to the 700-line limit. Consider extracting the journey-details card (destination + duration) into a component.

fieldsLocked = !!journeyToken works because GO1B is on and Head Out always passes a token, so the 'pre-filled but editable' path from Head Out only happens when Head Out's POST failed. This matches the design but is worth knowing.
useJourneyGPS cancellation fix confirmed in code: the watcher is removed when cancelled after watchPositionAsync resolves (line 171).
guardian/[token].tsx:133: isClosed now checks status, closed_at and safe_at. Verified against the live API, which returns status=in_progress plus closed_at for a revoked journey.

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend-only batch; 1/1 setup API test passed)
success_rate.frontend: 94% (custom-duration typing bug is the only failing requirement)

seed_data_creation: Created trusted-circle invites TEST_Guardian91 (voicetest2026 → fir-test-user2, phone 9000000002) and journeys TEST_RevokePlace x2, TEST_Library Road, TEST_Hostel (create blocked, not stored), TEST_Market Square, TEST_Bus Stand Gate 2. All created journeys were revoked by token. Link 9191f3c5-22eb-4437-9a26-d84482d482f5 was revoked; the TEST_Guardian91 link from the first pytest run (id not captured) may still be active. Circles and Head Out sessions were only in browser localStorage. No seeded or user data was changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login by injecting gk_token, gk_user, gk_lang (JSON {code:'en'}), lang_onboarded_v1_<uid>='1' AND ws_panic_lesson_seen='1'. Without the last one, /women-shield auto-redirects to /women/panic-lesson on the first visit. The Guardian Journey row has testID ws-tool-people-circle-outline. The circle goes in localStorage ws_trusted_circle_<uid>. Stub window.open to capture sms: (tel: uses window.location on RN-web, so it cannot be captured). Head Out uses DestinationPicker (dp-destination-input) and chips headout-dur-30/60/120/240. GO1B is on, so headout-start POSTs a journey record. To test the guardian view, run tests/test_it91_guardian_revoked_view.py, which writes /tmp/it91_guardian_state.json with the recipient token and journey token. Check custom duration by typing key by key (page.keyboard.type), not with fill().
rca_of_issue: Custom duration: the onChangeText handler applies every in-range prefix (1 → 14 → 144) before the final out-of-range keystroke (1441), which only sets the error and does not restore the earlier duration. fill() sets the whole value at once, so it hides the bug. Reproduce: open /women/guardian-share, tap Custom and type 1441 one key at a time. The error shows, but Check-in moves to now+144 min.
